about_the_game:
Welcome to D.I.C.E.!

Brave enough to play? No?

Too bad. You're chosen. There's no escape.

Tonight you play D.I.C.E, a game of Death, Intellect, Cruelty and Elegance.

A delightful dinner where dice are served as your final course,

beneath the glow of our exquisite Art Deco establishment.

And watching people gamble for their lives is truly beautiful.

But don't worry.

If luck is on your side, you may survive.

Rules of the Table

Face off in a tense 1v1 match, either against a cunning AI or another player online.

Both of you are served 5 dice. The goal is simple: roll the best hand, using rules inspired by Poker with a few twists.

Not happy with your dice? Use Gambits, special actions that let you reroll, manipulate or even sabotage your opponent’s plans.

Keep winning rounds until only one remains standing at the dinner table.

What's on the Table

Dice: Each player rolls 5 dice to form hands based on modified Poker rules, incl. Flush.

Gambits: Choose from over 10 different Gambits that allow you to reroll dice, manipulate outcomes, or disrupt your opponent’s strategy.

Match: Claim victory in a Best-of-3 by reducing your opponent’s health to zero.

Singleplayer: Play against AI opponents of varying difficulty.

Multiplayer: Engage in online matches with friends or random players through matchmaking or private lobbies.

Unlocks: Progress and earn new cosmetic rewards by winning matches.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.5 Ghz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3 Ghz+
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A tense gambling duel in an elegant Art Deco world where luck and strategy decide who survives. Roll five dice and build winning hands inspired by poker. Use Gambits to reroll, sabotage your opponent and turn your fate. Win rounds and outlast your rival. Only one leaves the dinner table.
